messages:
sam: FYI — quant bring-up for rwd-medium-3 on int cluster showing regression on summarization + instruction-following.
mia: ugh, how big? any perf vs fp16 baseline numbers?
sam: throughput ok, latency fine. quality delta is ~6 pts ROUGE-L on our short-summary promptset. failing examples attached.
aj: can you drop a few examples inline? easier than hunting in storage.
sam: here —
```
input: "Long meeting minutes..."
fp16: "TL;DR: team decided to postpone launch."
int8-quant: "They postponed something? unclear." 
```
nora: that looks like prefix truncation / context window handling — but could also be quant noise.
mia: two parallel things: (1) dataset curation for a small targeted golden set to triage, (2) dedupe + sampling so labelers don't get duplicates during relabel.
sam: agree. propose a 500-example triage golden: 200 fail-candidates from current run, 200 stratified random from dev, 100 edgecases (multisentence, bullet lists, docs).
aj: labeler team can take 100/day. we should prioritize fail-candidates first.
labeler-bot: queued 100 fail-candidates to `label-relabel` pool. ETA: 18h.
mia: also need an embed-fingerprint dedupe pass — duplicate noise is making regression signal noisy.
nora: I can run a quick embed-fingerprint script with cosine>0.95 filter and surface 2k collisions. I'll drop the CSV in #eng-ml.
sam: thanks. after label pass, we'll run quant-smoke + eval harness (diff + significance test). if regression persists, rollback quant profile and open bug for kernel selection.
aj: schedule a 30m sync tomorrow 10:30 to lock sampling rules & relabel SLAs. I'll send calendar invite. @sam @mia @nora
sam: ack. also adding a canary route: 5% traffic to int8-quant variant with automatic fallback on quality alert.
deploy-bot: canary created: route=rwd-medium-3-int8; traffic=5%; monitor=eval-golden-smoke.
mia: one more ask — include metadata tags on examples: "source", "promo vs organic", "contains-code". helps slice analyses.
sam: good call. I'll update extraction pipeline.
aj: FYI, if label backlog spikes ping me and we'll throttle sampling or spin up 2 extra contractors.
nora: uploading dedupe CSV now -> https://internal.redwood/s/3678
sam: closing loop: triage golden dataset + dedupe pass + labeler prioritization + canary. follow-ups in calendar invite. :thumbsup:
